statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring)
The diagnosis codes submitted are Z86.73, G45.9, and I49.9
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with rhythm disturbances
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources contributing to transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
